summary: Master Performance Management Systems Design. Learn to implement OKRs, Balanced Scorecard, and data-driven KPIs to drive organizational results. Enroll today.
lede: Performance management training helps HR partners, talent specialists, and people managers connect strategy to goals and reviews. They practise building a goal cascade, review tools, and a KPI dashboard, then setting SMART objectives, assessing evidence, and calibrating ratings to support consistent evaluations and development follow-through.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate, govern, or use performance management systems across business functions. It suits intermediate practitioners who can relate the design work to an existing people process, HR platform, or manager workflow.
audience: Compensation Analysts using calibrated ratings in reward
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to HR processes, people management, talent management, or organizational development. Familiarity with employee objectives, performance reviews, or HR information systems is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You will work with supplied sample data and templates rather than needing access to an employer's confidential employee records.
